params.body:
The revocation section of `docs/protocol.md` described the gateway reading revocations as a plan, and said a capability the hand already holds stands until it expires. Both are built now:
- Portal serves the jti of every capability ended early at `/api/ingest/control/revoked`.
- The gateway reads that list every half minute and refuses an action under a listed jti (control `cmd/gateway/revoked.go`).

The section now says what runs. It also says what is not reached yet: a B1 word for reading a running system goes to the system itself, which does not read the list.

Docs only, no app change.
